title: &aHearth and Harvest
subtitle: The Ashborn still has to eat. Last Light feeds itself.

quests.title: &aHunt and Gather
quests.subtitle: Undying isn't the same as fed.
description: You can't die for good. You can still go hungry, and a hungry Ashborn can't sprint, can't heal and can't outrun much of anything.
Craft a &6knife&r from flint or iron. It takes more from the world than a sword does: straw from grass, ham from pigs, slices from a fish.
&o"The villages that lived through the Eclipse learned one thing before swordplay. Supper."&r

quests.title: Grasping at Straws
quests.subtitle: Nothing in a village goes to waste.
description: Cut grass, wheat or rice with your knife and keep the &6straw&r.
Straw twists into rope and canvas. Rope climbs, and tomatoes climb it too. Canvas keeps the rain off the larder.

quests.title: Plant Food
quests.subtitle: Rot, patience, then something green.
description: Mix &6Organic Compost&r from dirt, straw, bone meal and rotten flesh (or tree bark), set it down and leave it be. Sunlight, water and nearby mushrooms hurry it along.
In time it turns into &6Rich Soil&r. Crops grown in it get a free push now and then, and mushrooms planted on it spread into colonies.
&7The dead feed the living. Even here.

quests.title: Crops of the Wild
quests.subtitle: Somebody planted these, once.
description: Wild &6cabbages&r, &6tomatoes&r, &6onions&r and &6rice&r still grow where farms stood before the Eclipse: on beaches, in the warm grasslands, along the rivers. Village farms sometimes keep a row of them.
Gather any of them and bring the seed home.

quests.title: Dipping Your Roots
quests.subtitle: Rice wants its feet wet.
description: Plant &6rice&r in water one block deep. It grows up out of the water and gives you grain and straw both.
Half the cooking pot's recipes start with rice. The other half want an onion.

quests.title: Rain on Demand
quests.subtitle: The sky stopped helping. Copper didn't.
description: Right-click a ripe crop to harvest and replant it in one motion. With a hoe in hand the harvest sweeps: iron or gold 3×3, diamond 5×5.
A &6Sprinkler&r (copper and a bucket) keeps a 9×9 field wet and growing about three times as fast. It needs water within four blocks, below it or beside it.

quests.title: The Crate That Farms
quests.subtitle: Let the box do the stooping.
description: A &6Farming Crate&r harvests, replants and stores everything in the 9×9 around it, and never voids a harvest. It is built around a diamond hoe, and diamond tools take a &6Duskforged Ingot&r in this world.
Set one in the middle of the village fields and go kill something. Supper will be waiting.

quests.title: Watch Your Fingers
quests.subtitle: Steel for the monsters. A board for the meat.
description: Place a &6Cutting Board&r, set an item on it and use it with a tool in hand. A knife slices meat, fish and vegetables; an axe strips logs and keeps the bark.
More food from less. That's the whole trick of surviving.

quests.title: &aDinner's Served
quests.subtitle: A stove, a pot, a reason to come home.
description: Build a &6Stove&r from bricks, iron and a campfire, and set a &6Cooking Pot&r on it. Any heat beneath will do; the stove just does it with dignity.
The pot takes up to six ingredients and a bowl, and gives back meals that keep you going far longer than raw meat ever did.
&o"A shrine warms the dead. A stove warms the living. Keep both lit."&r

quests.title: Portable Cooking
quests.subtitle: Supper on the road.
description: Hold a &6Skillet&r in one hand and raw food in the other, stand near a fire, and cook as you go. Sneak to set it down as a block over a fire or a stove, and it cooks there too.
It also makes a perfectly respectable club. Nobody has to know.

quests.title: Nourishing!
quests.subtitle: A full belly outlasts a long fight.
description: Plated meals grant &6Nourishment&r: your hunger stops draining while it lasts. Soups and stews grant &6Comfort&r: you heal naturally however empty your stomach is.
Eat one before a long dungeon and you won't be chewing bread in the middle of a boss's second phase.

quests.title: &aA Glorious Feast
quests.subtitle: Some meals are meant for the whole village.
description: Cook a &6feast&r (a Roast Chicken, a Stuffed Pumpkin, a Honey Glazed Ham or a Shepherd's Pie) and set it down. Anyone with a bowl can take a serving.
The sellswords of the Ashen Company will fight for gold. They'll stay for this.

quests.title: Master of the Last Kitchen
quests.subtitle: Every dish, at least once.
description: Eat a course of every meal the cooking pot knows. It's a long menu. You have, technically, forever.
&7A long-term goal. Your advancements list the dishes you still owe.

quests.title: Here Starts the Process
quests.subtitle: Patience, in a barrel.
description: A &6Keg&r (iron, planks and a honeycomb) ferments drinks and cheese from a base liquid and up to four ingredients. Pour from it into &6tankards&r.
Some brews want warmth, some want cold. A &6Heating Cask&r or an &6Ice Crate&r next to the keg shifts its temperature.
&o"The Company says it can't fight sober. I've seen it fight drunk. Brew anyway."&r

quests.title: Mead for the Living
quests.subtitle: Honey, wheat and sweet berries. And time.
description: Fill a keg with honey, add wheat, seeds and sweet berries, and wait. &6Mead&r is what the Ashen Company drinks to its dead.
Every brew leaves you a little &6Tipsy&r. Don't roll into a fight seeing double.

quests.title: Strongroot Ale
quests.subtitle: Beer, improved by things that grow underground.
description: Brew plain &6beer&r first: water, wheat, seeds and a brown mushroom. Then ferment that beer again with beetroot, potato, another mushroom and a strip of &6jerky&r.
&6Strongroot Ale&r is a miner's drink. It makes a long day underground feel shorter, and the walk home feel longer.

quests.title: Taste of Time
quests.subtitle: The one thing here that improves with age.
description: Ferment milk with a brown mushroom, pumpkin seeds and sugar in a &6warm&r keg. Draw the full keg off with a &6honeycomb&r for a rind and you get an &6Unripe Cheese Wheel&r. Set it down and leave it alone.
When it's ripe, cut it into wedges on a board. Cheese keeps. Most things in this world don't.

quests.title: A Line in Dark Water
quests.subtitle: Fish don't care what happened to the sun.
description: Craft an &6Iron Fishing Rod&r. Aquaculture's rods take a &6hook&r, &6bait&r, a coloured line and a bobber; fit them at a &6Tackle Box&r.
Every water keeps its own fish: rivers, oceans, jungles, swamps and frozen seas.

quests.title: The Ones That Didn't Get Away
quests.subtitle: Every fisher has a story. Bring proof.
description: Land a &6Tuna&r from the open ocean and a &6Catfish&r from a river or lake inland.
Fillet the big ones with a &6Fillet Knife&r. A tuna feeds a table. A catfish feeds the village cats, mostly.

quests.title: Home of Saylor
quests.subtitle: Someone on the shore kept fishing through the end of the world.
description: A &6Fisherman's Cottage&r sits on a sandy or snowy beach. Saylor lives there, and trades things no village fisherman will.
The coast has six more places like it, each with its own resident: Harbourmaster Wren, Keeper Morrow, Old Bayou Tam, Frost-Beard Ole, Ferryman Hale… and two deckhands who don't say much anymore.

quests.title: Pot Luck
quests.subtitle: Bait it, sink it, walk away.
description: Knot &6Fishing Nets&r from string, then a &6Crab Pot&r from nets and sticks, or buy one from a coast fisherman. Set it in open water with &6bait&r inside.
&6Fish Bait&r is seeds and rotten flesh. &6Chum&r and &6Glow Bait&r are the others; the swamp folk swear by chum. Rain doubles the catch, and a hopper underneath empties the pot for you.

quests.title: Message Received
quests.subtitle: Twelve notes from the sea. Most of them are complaints.
description: Now and then a rod or a crab pot brings up a &6Message in a Bottle&r. Open it. Some hold a little treasure; some hold a &6Bottled Map to a Wreck&r.
The sea had a lot to say before the Eclipse. It hasn't stopped.

quests.title: Keeper of the Light
quests.subtitle: Another fire someone refused to let go out.
description: On a stony shore stands a &6Lighthouse&r. Keeper Morrow lives there, and trades with anyone who makes the climb.
&o"A keeper of a light, by the sea. We'd have a great deal to talk about, he and I."&r

quests.title: &aCoastal Wanderer
quests.subtitle: Seven places on the water.
description: Visit all seven: the Cottage, the Harbour Pier, the Lighthouse, the Stilt Shack, the Ice Fishing Camp, the River Boathouse and, under twelve blocks of water, the &6Sunken Trawler&r.
&7The captain's chest on the trawler sometimes holds a Heart of the Sea. The drowned deckhands would rather it didn't.

quests.title: Game in the Ash
quests.subtitle: The deer survived the Eclipse. Mostly by running.
description: The wild keeps its own larder: &6venison&r from deer, &6drumsticks&r from turkeys, &6duck&r from the ponds, &6crab meat&r on the beaches.
Deer bolt at the first footstep. Come at them slowly, or bring a bow.
